title: Design snapshot dependency layer
description: Links between things the rest of the snapshot already names: which components bind which tokens and for which properties, which tokens alias which per mode, which components nest which, and which text styles are used. Optional; present only when manifest.dependencies.captured is true. Apart from nestsUncaptured and unresolvedBindings, every id and path here must resolve in tokens.json, typography.json, or components.json.

aliases.description: One entry per variable per mode. The same from/to pair repeats across modes, because a token can point at a different primitive in each theme. Sorted by from, then mode.

mode.description: The Figma mode name, matching a mode in manifest.collections.

components.description: One entry per walked component that has at least one link, sorted by id. A component with no dependencies is left out.

tokenPath.description: Dot-separated path to a token, as keyed in tokens.json or typography.json. Sanitised per references/figma-mapping.md, so it contains no { or }.

componentDependencies.description: All five link arrays are always present, empty when there is nothing. Never omit a key to signal absence.

bindings.description: Tokens this component binds. A token appears at most once, with its properties merged. Sorted by token.

properties.description: Figma boundVariables keys, e.g. fills, strokes, paddingLeft. Sorted.

nests.description: Components in components.json that this one contains. Sorted by id.

nestsUncaptured.description: Nested components that were not walked, usually living in a Figma file the bridge was not paired with, or private parts. Kept by raw Figma name so the dependency stays visible. Sorted by name.

unresolvedBindings.description: Bindings whose variable maps to no token in this snapshot, kept by raw Figma name. A dangling link is a finding, not a reason to drop it. Sorted by figmaName.
